- **Why it stands out:** You literally step right into them without bending over, and the washable insoles knock out foot odor fast. Explore models on [Kizik](https://kizik.com/).[[1]](https://www.travelandleisure.com/style/shoes/best-slip-on-sneakers)

#### Golden Rules for Washing Sneakers

- **Take out the guts:** Always pull out the **insoles** and **laces** before they go in the machine. Wash laces inside a small mesh bag so they don't wrap around the agitator.[[1]](https://www.allbirds.com/pages/shoe-care)
- **Bag 'em up:** Use a dedicated **delicates laundry bag** or a clean pillowcase to buffer the shoes from bashing against the glass door or drum.[[1]](https://www.allbirds.com/pages/shoe-care)
- **Keep it cold & gentle:** Use **cold water** and a mild liquid detergent. Skip bleach and fabric softeners (softeners can break down technical fabrics and adhesives).[[1]](https://www.allbirds.com/pages/shoe-care)
- **No heat, ever:** **Air-dry** them away from direct high heat or dryers; tossing sneakers in a dryer can warp the rubber soles and shrink the upper materials. Stuffing them with a dry towel or shoe tree helps them keep their form while they dry.[[1]](https://rothys.com/pages/care-guide)[[2]](https://www.allbirds.com/pages/shoe-care)
